title: Asian stocks rise on expectations of a pause in Fed rate hikes and the Nikkei nears 70,000 points
summary: Weak U.S. employment data reduce bets on further rate hikes, pushing the Nikkei to 34-year highs and lifting other Asian markets.

title: AkzoNobel sells its Southeast Asian paints business to Nippon Paint for $1.35 billion
summary: The Dutch giant divests its decorative paints division to Japan's Nippon Paint to focus on its core activities.

title: CSL and Alentis Therapeutics agree up to $1.6 billion to develop a drug for rare diseases
summary: Australian pharmaceutical CSL will pay up to $1.6 billion to Alentis for the development of lixudebart, boosting its shares.
